results.content: Amid President Donald Trump’s record-low approval ratings nationally, a new YouGov/Economist projection shows the president's net job approval is negative in all but three states. According to The Economist and YouGov, more people disapprove than approve of Trump’s job performance in 47 out of 50 states and in the District of Columbia. The three states where the majority of respondents still approve of the president are Wyoming (+14), Idaho (+9), and West Virginia (+6). The lowest net job approval rating for Trump was in D.C. results.content: President Donald Trump has broken his own record for the lowest approval rating recorded by The Economist/YouGov, with just 33 percent of Americans now saying they approve of the way he is handling his job as president. What To Know The significance of the latest result is ultimately less about one number than about the trajectory. Trump Hits New Lows Among Key Blocs Trump’s approval is also reaching new lows across several key voting blocs. Trump has a new net approval low among white Americans too, with a 39 percent approval in the new poll compared to 57 percent disapproval.
